assumptionLedger.eligibility: Magic Solar with Lesser/ordinary/Greater Infinite, or Rare Solar with Perfect Infinite at catalog item level 72+. All three sourced attribute outcomes must be eligible. Perfect replacement requires every unlocked, side-restricted removal branch to permit all three outcomes; otherwise block the whole action.
assumptionLedger.reason: Sourced effects define exact modifier results; no published essence choice weights. Ordinary spawn weights are not essence selection weights.

assumptionLedger.eligibility: Validated Rare Solar with at least four supported explicit modifiers and no existing fracture, including verified essence results. Implicit modifiers are excluded. Only one explicit fracture is supported.
assumptionLedger.reason: Effect and ordinary explicit candidate set are sourced; published fracture selection weights are unavailable.

assumptionLedger.eligibility: Validated Solar Amulet, Magic/Rare, no special conditions. Non-Fractured explicit instances after verified side restriction; Chaos requires Rare and replacement eligibility for every removal branch. Whittling with fracture is blocked pending priority verification. Hysteria requires Rare Solar at catalog item level 68 or above and a valid fixed suffix after every non-Fractured explicit removal; One Crystallisation omen restricts Hysteria removal to unlocked prefixes or suffixes before determining N; its paired combination is unsupported. Perfect Infinite requires Rare Solar at catalog item level 72+ and all three sourced percentage suffix outcomes valid after every eligible removal. Crystallisation restrictions also apply to this Perfect essence. Perfect Enhancement requires Rare Solar at modifier item level 72+ and its sourced global defences prefix valid after every eligible removal; the same Crystallisation restrictions apply. Essence of the Breach requires Rare Solar at modifier level 1+ and its fixed maximum-quality prefix valid after every eligible removal; Crystallisation restrictions apply. Runic Alloy requires Rare Solar at modifier level 13+ and a valid sourced Runic Ward prefix after every unlocked explicit removal. Crystallisation does not apply to Alloy. Abyss requires Rare Solar level 1+ with both sourced Mark affixes valid after every eligible removal; Crystallisation affects removal only, not the outcome affix.
assumptionLedger.reason: Random removal stated; no published per-instance removal weights.

assumptionLedger.candidateUnit: integer value in a single source stat range
assumptionLedger.eligibility: Supported modifier (published-weight draw or essence outcome) with exactly one stat; all integers from min through max inclusive in source units. Joint-stat domains are rejected.
assumptionLedger.reason: Source ranges define the modeled candidates; no numeric roll weights. Display units may differ from source units.
